Du löst ein Single-Item Lot-Sizing-Problem mit Kapazitätsrestriktion über 25 Perioden. In jeder Periode kann produziert werden (mit fixen Setup-Kosten, falls produziert wird, plus variablen Produktionskosten pro Einheit), bis zur jeweiligen Kapazitätsgrenze. Nicht verkaufte Mengen werden mit Lagerkosten pro Einheit auf die Folgeperiode übertragen. Kein Anfangsbestand. Ziel: Minimiere die Gesamtkosten (Setup + Produktion + Lagerhaltung) über alle Perioden, sodass die Nachfrage jeder Periode exakt gedeckt wird.

import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 38, "setup_cost": 462, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "2": {"demand": 24, "setup_cost": 401, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "3": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 271, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "4": {"demand": 31, "setup_cost": 481, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "5": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 477, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "6": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 372, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "7": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 109, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "8": {"demand": 16, "setup_cost": 138, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "9": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 376, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "10": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 451, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "11": {"demand": 40, "setup_cost": 103, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "12": {"demand": 10, "setup_cost": 105, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "13": {"demand": 44, "setup_cost": 426, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "14": {"demand": 34, "setup_cost": 138, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "15": {"demand": 25, "setup_cost": 285, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "16": {"demand": 24, "setup_cost": 191, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "17": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 470, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "18": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 472, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "19": {"demand": 16, "setup_cost": 193, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "20": {"demand": 25, "setup_cost": 281, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "21": {"demand": 23, "setup_cost": 264, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "22": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 277, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "23": {"demand": 18, "setup_cost": 156, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "24": {"demand": 33, "setup_cost": 179, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "25": {"demand": 43, "setup_cost": 225, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 38, "2": 36, "3": 13, "4": 36, "5": 34, "6": 17, "7": 35, "8": 14,
    "9": 19, "10": 45, "11": 40, "12": 14, "13": 53, "14": 46, "15": 30,
    "16": 17, "17": 19, "18": 19, "19": 12, "20": 20, "21": 24, "22": 23,
    "23": 14, "24": 36, "25": 31
}

# Erstelle das Modell
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), name="production", vtype=GRB.INTEGER)
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), name="setup", vtype=GRB.BINARY)
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), name="inventory", vtype=GRB.INTEGER)

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere Gesamtkosten
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfragebedingung
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbedingung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Lösen des Modells
model.optimize()

# Ausgabe der Ergebnisse
result = {
    "production": {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

import json
print(json.dumps(result))
